about: The agent skills this repo's workflow calls. Personal scope, never vendored: a personal skill of the same name would shadow a repo copy. /setup-skills installs anything missing into ~/.claude/skills and updates the rest; the SessionStart hook in .claude/settings.json reports what is missing. Keep this file identical in every repo that shares the workflow.

skills.name: code-review
skills.role: the review chunk: standards and spec, in parallel

skills.name: receiving-code-review
skills.role: how review findings are weighed before they are applied

skills.name: domain-modeling
skills.role: glossary and decision records during a grill

skills.name: triage
skills.role: moves issues through the five triage labels

skills.name: to-spec
skills.role: a conversation into a spec issue

skills.name: wayfinder
skills.role: a map of decision issues for work too big for one session

skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skills.role: the design gate: styles, palettes, type, a11y
